2608.07107.title: MemWM: Memory-Augmented Text-Based World Model
2608.07107.paper_summary: World models are increasingly used to support planning in agents by predicting how environment states evolve in response to agent actions. Yet fluent next-state predictions can still omit task-critical facts, corrupt product attributes, or apply incorrect transition rules. To address such systematic prediction errors, we introduce MemWM, a memory-augmented text-based world model. MemWM uses world memory, a curated memory bank of transition rules, state caches, and hard-to-predict facts, to condition next-state imagination. We evaluate factual state preservation with Structured State Fidelity (SSF), which scores predicted states through benchmark-specific facts and fields. Compared with SFT, memory-augmented training improves SSF by up to 206.3%. In the full planning setting, we keep the policy model frozen and provide policy-side world skill: retrieved task-level skills and step-wise corrective guidance for action selection. Across ALFWorld, WebShop, and ScienceWorld, memory-augmented agents improve downstream success over an SFT-trained world-model agent, with up to a 65.4% relative gain. Sensitivity analyses further show that retrieved memory improves task success and efficiency under different memory and action-budget settings.
2608.07107.paper_summary_zh: 世界模型越來越多地用於支持代理的規劃，通過預測環境狀態如何隨著代理行動而演變。<lb/>然而，流暢的下一狀態預測仍可能忽略任務關鍵事實，損壞產品屬性，或應用錯誤的轉換規則。<lb/>為了解決這些系統性預測錯誤，我們引入了MemWM，一種增強記憶的基於文本的世界模型。<lb/>MemWM使用世界記憶，一個經過策劃的轉換規則、狀態緩存和難以預測事實的記憶庫，以調節下一狀態的想像。<lb/>我們通過結構化狀態保真度（SSF）來評估事實狀態的保留，該指標通過基準特定的事實和領域來評分預測的狀態。<lb/>與SFT相比，增強記憶的訓練將SSF提高了最多206.3%。<lb/>在完整的規劃設置中，我們保持政策模型不變，並提供政策側的世界技能：檢索的任務級技能和逐步的行動選擇糾正指導。<lb/>在ALFWorld、WebShop和ScienceWorld中，增強記憶的代理在下游成功方面超過了SFT訓練的世界模型代理，達到最多65.4%的相對增益。<lb/>敏感性分析進一步顯示，檢索的記憶在不同的記憶和行動預算設置下改善了任務成功和效率。
